Author: Serpens66
Name: Random Events
Description: Runs configurable Vanilla scenario events in skirmishes, Trail missions, and multiplayer games.

Changes: Delayed multiplayer initialization until the map startup is stable and prevented multiple Random Events Chores in one simulation tick.
Added a fail-closed peer acknowledgement handshake before signposts or event batches can change the synchronized simulation.
Added fail-closed Chore serializer self-tests and packet hashes to diagnose multiplayer transport corruption.
Added matching PRNG, action-order, and state digests for precise host/client desync comparison.
Enabled Random Events in multiplayer through Script Extender's tick-aligned Chore transport.
Implemented shared rolls that affect every living human equally and independent per-player rolls that can produce different events.

Made the host authoritative for the private event PRNG while preserving identical Vanilla RNG call order on every peer, and replaced the bandit real-time delay with a deterministic simulation-tick delay.
Made all numeric event settings directly editable, including chances, intervals, group factors, and plague and fire ranges.
Added temporary Script Extender compatibility fixes for multiplayer settings synchronization during lobby joins, reliable lobby delivery, and authenticated in-game host updates.
Updated shared lobby settings for Script Extender 1.42.0 by avoiding redundant UI-only persistence and using the official multiplayer-game signal.
Added optional Serps Mods Host dependency for Workshop mod-pack load ordering.
Use Script Extender 1.41's official owner-then-color unit-spawn contract with explicit named arguments.
Update the native event documentation now that the former spawn-parameter workaround is part of the official API.
Added meaningful units to Slider value displays, highlighted activation, and enlarged the shared tooltip presentation.
Grouped event probabilities into positive and negative events and added opaque, automatically wrapping tooltips.
Use audited RVAs directly for the known CrusaderDE.dll and scan signatures only as an unknown-DLL fallback.
Added a configurable per-event cooldown with shared and player-specific state.
Delegated optional mission-preset coordination to CustomCustomTrail; local presets remain standalone.
Added mission-bound Trail presets from .modjson and CustomCustomTrail schema-2 missions, including shared customization UI.
Added two automatically saved lobby-settings presets with migration of existing settings to preset 1.
Added all 15 Vanilla random events for offline skirmishes and Trail missions.
